item.ptxt: With IG ON, the monitor display priority is: PCS Wrn display > Initial Check display > DTC display > ACC display > warning display > drive monitor display. With IG OFF, only the warning display is shown.
*1: In the initial state (when the battery is connected), the display starts from the clock display. (During normal operation of the IG switch, the display starts from the previous state)
*2: Press the "DISP" switch to cycle through the drive monitor displays in order. (Including warnings and ACC displays inserted by interruption)
*3: If the display switches to a higher priority display (warning display or DTC display) during clock setting, the display after the higher priority display is cancelled is used.
*4: Pressing and holding the "DISP" switch for 0.8s or more resets the displayed value.
*5: Pressing and holding the "DISP" switch for 1.0s or more switches to clock setting mode.

step3.ptxt: When warnings occur, they are displayed in order from the lowest display priority level number.
